title: Frequency and period
text: The (angular) frequency of a periodic function is $$2\pi$$ over the period: \n $$\frac{2\pi}{P}$$, where $$P$$ is the minimum period.

title: Frequency and period
text: The larger the frequency corresponds to the smaller period.

title: Period and frequency of each graph
text: The period of $$\sin(Ax)$$ is pi. The frequency is $$\frac{2\pi}{\pi}=2$$. \n The period of $$\sin(Bx)$$ is $$2$$. The frequency is $$\frac{2\pi}{2}=pi$$. Note that $$2<\pi$$.
